title: Claude Code: Build Production-Ready Features with Skills, Agents & Hooks
description:
Claude Code isn't just an AI coding assistant — it's a full AI engineering team. In this video, we go beyond simple prompts and turn Claude Code into a system that understands your entire codebase, follows your team's engineering standards through reusable Skills, and delegates work to specialized Agents — just like a real engineering team.

We work with a real TypeScript MCP (Model Context Protocol) server — a DevOps Incident Response MCP Server — not a toy demo project. You'll see Claude Code explain the architecture, trace how requests flow through the server, and navigate a multi-file codebase automatically.

Then we build a custom "MCP Best Practices" Skill to enforce coding standards, create a Developer Agent to implement new features, and a QA Engineer Agent to generate comprehensive unit tests and validate the implementation. Finally, we bring it all together to build a brand-new MCP tool (get_service_logs) from a single high-level request — complete with documentation and unit tests, automatically.

What you'll learn in this video:
- How Claude Code understands and navigates an entire codebase
- The difference between Claude Code Skills and Agents, and when to use each
- How to create a reusable Skill to enforce coding standards
- How to build specialized Agents (Developer, QA Engineer) for delegated workflows
- How to use Claude Code to implement a new MCP tool end-to-end
- How Claude Code Hooks fit into automating and enforcing standards
- Real production-ready AI-assisted backend engineering, not a hello-world demo
